title: From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy
abstract: arXiv:2610.25496v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for interaction semantics. translated_title: 从提议到执行：共享自主性中的交互语义建模
translated_abstract: 在许多人机（人类-AI）系统中，候选动作并不会被直接执行，而是首先由另一个决策实体在可能不同的目标或决策模型下进行评估。标准的决策理论框架并不要求显式地表示这种交互，因为它们直接在状态-动作对上定义转移动态，从而允许将评估过程吸收进转移模型之中。我们引入了一个语义感知的决策框架，其中候选动作被提议后，会在交互上下文中进行评估，然后被解析为最终的执行结果。我们通过联合动作语言和解释函数将其形式化，该解释函数将每个联合动作及其上下文映射到相应的语义结果。转移动态和奖励动态通过这些语义结果被诱导出来，从而为交互语义引入了一个显式的表示层。语义结果为组织……提供了显式单元（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个语义感知的决策框架，将“动作提议—上下文评估—结果执行”这一交互过程显式建模，填补了标准决策理论中评估过程被隐式吸收进转移动态的表示空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a semantics-aware decision framework that explicitly models the propose-evaluate-execute interaction process, addressing the gap in standard decision theory where evaluation is implicitly absorbed into the transition dynamics.
